data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to integrate Google Wallet and save passes via JWT
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to check if the Google Wallet API is available, save passes using a JWT, and display a Google Wallet button widget.
use_when: You need to integrate Google Wallet passes into your Android Flutter application.
You want to provide a native Google Wallet button.
avoid_when: You are building for iOS (unless handling separately, as this is an Android-focused plugin).
You need blockchain or crypto wallet features instead of Google Wallet passes.
strengths: Provides a dedicated Google Wallet button widget.
Easy methods to check availability and save passes via JWT.
weaknesses: Not an officially supported Google product.
Requires external setup on Android following Google Wallet guides.
data.setup_notes: Requires following the setup guide for Google Wallet on Android in the prerequisites.

alternatives.name: apple_passkit
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if you need Apple Wallet integration instead of Google Wallet.
